title: Works-Execution Standards Registry
description: Machine-readable registry of every external standard/framework/spec that the works-execution venture has evaluated, plus the 22 new internal Action/CI standards. Each row is auditable, carries its own status, and is linked from the kanban board and per-domain mapping documents.

status_legend.NOT_APPLICABLE: The standard does not apply to works-execution (with reason in `not_applicable_reason`).
status_legend.PLANNED: Accepted as in-scope. No implementation yet.
status_legend.PARTIAL: Some requirements implemented; gap analysis present in the mapping document.
status_legend.IMPLEMENTED: All applicable requirements are implemented; evidence exists; awaiting verification.
status_legend.VERIFIED: IMPLEMENTED + verified by tests, audit, or external attestation with a recorded evidence pointer.
status_legend.BLOCKED: Cannot proceed without an external dependency (audit, certification, vendor).

standards.requirement: Every Action declares: id, version, runtime, image, inputs, outputs, CPU, memory, GPU, env, FS, network, secrets, permissions, timeout, retries, cache, artifacts, side effects, rollback.

standards.requirement: Default: network=deny, secrets=none, FS=isolated, permissions=minimal. Broader authority must be explicit and policy-approved.
standards.implementation: Slice 3: default-deny subprocess sandbox; admission rejects undeclared capabilities.

standards.requirement: Identical source + Action + inputs + deps + toolchain + env → identical or explainably equivalent results.
standards.implementation: Slice 3: fingerprint = sha256(source + action + inputs + env); cache key includes fingerprint; equivalent results explained via fingerprint.

standards.requirement: Every execution generates a durable evidence bundle: id, timestamps, actor, source, workflow, Actions, runner, inputs, env, logs, tests, security findings, artifacts, provenance, signatures, final result.
standards.implementation: docs/standards/schemas/evidence-bundle.schema.json + internal/standards package. Producer service: services/evidence/ (PLANNED).

standards.requirement: No static cloud credentials; prefer OIDC federation, SPIFFE workload identity, short-lived tokens, JIT credentials, scoped credentials.
standards.implementation: Slice 3: worker enrollment uses OIDC token exchange (or dev-mode SPIFFE-like signed enrollment token); API rejects static API keys.

standards.requirement: Identify immutable content by digest: source, deps, Actions, envs, caches, artifacts, workflows.
